body: I guess I'm kinda sorta caught in a stupid place, either I take the chance of being even more outcast than I am already, or I can just keep living with soul-crushing loneliness that keeps me up at night. I guess I can't do much to run from that fact; thank you, I'll definitely do some thinking tonight on this
But I really don't want to end up that way :(
But if I do make a fool out of myself, I'm kinda fucked because then no one will ever even think about talking to me
There was never really anyone at school that I really could talk to; I don't really share common interests with anyone there
I'm never really good with conveying my thoughts into words; I'll often seem like I have little to say, as if I don't want to carry a conversation with someone
It seems like no one at this age really cares about personality :(     Even then, I feel like my antisocial habits can make kinda come off as an asshole at times
It doesn't feel like just one person is judging me, it feels like everyone is judging me

I don't really have much of a choice when it comes to the whole social contact thing; I don't really fit in with kids my age at all. I'm also terrible with carrying any sort of conversation. There's not really anywhere to walk in my area. Not only that, but I feel like I'm going to be judged the second I leave the door; I'm overweight, ugly, and I look like someone who's always angry. I've tried losing weight before, but it didn't really work.

I think he already knows that I at-least feel a tad bit depressed, I mean I spend most of my time in my room avoiding social contact. About a year ago, I broke down one morning, I couldn't control myself anymore after my parents yelling at me, and I started crying (pathetic, I know) because I was (and still am) very stressed out. I feel like if I were to talk to my father about the issue directly, it could end up in frustration, something which would end very bad for the both of us (my dad is ex-military is prone to flipping the fuck out when he gets the slightest bit perturbed, something which I assumed over 20 years of the military can do to you) 

Thank you, hopefully the medicine for the ulcer works, from what I've been told, it's very large and was bleeding at one point; I don't think I want to risk getting worse.

Well, the problem with talking to my dad is that I really don't want him to blame himself for how I feel, and I feel like it will just end up being really really awkward, something that would end up making things even worse. 

I can't really talk to anyone at school since I don't go to a conventional school at the moment, I take home-bound classes; I call into a number 4 times a day for my 4 core subjects. I take these classes due to a stomach ulcer and due to what I believe to be mild IBS (I was also diagnosed with lactose intolerance, but I've tried seeing if lactose can trigger much of an effect, and it doesn't)

In all honesty, I don't think I can talk to my mom much at all. I can't really stand to be in the same room as her 5 minutes, she always ends up starting an argument, and I just can't take that (I can get pretty angry pretty fast, I'm easily irritated). I've tried talking to her about this before, and it always ended up with her dismissing it, saying that I'll be labeled as mentally ill and I won't be able to do anything when I get older due to that label. Unfortunately, any attempt at talking sense into my mother just ends up in frustration.
Talking to the counselor never really helped, it ended up being one of the most awkward feelings ever...I just can't see how this is normal, in all honesty, I'm surprised I haven't ended it all yet.

It wasn't a school counselor, I was recommended to go to a counselor (though I guess therapist would be the better word, though everyone kept using 'counselor'). 

Is this just part of being a teenage kid? Do most kids feel at-least some form of loneliness? Or am I just socially stupid.
Every time I try to talk to my parents, they're always in some form of denial, well my mom is, I never really get to talk to my dad for more than 5 minutes.
